audit_status.source_base: Greek 1 John text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact draft reviewed for children of Divine, sin/lawlessness, Cain, love in action, confidence, commandment.

verses.restored: See what kind of love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of Divine; and we are. Because of this the world-system does not know us, because it did not know him.

familiar.text: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.

verses.restored: Beloved, now we are children of Divine, and it has not yet been manifested what we will be. We know that if he is manifested, we will be like him, because we will see him just as he is.

familiar.text: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.

verses.restored: And everyone having this hope upon him purifies oneself, just as that one is pure.

familiar.text: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.

verses.restored: Everyone doing sin/misalignment also does lawlessness, and sin/misalignment is lawlessness.

familiar.text: Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.

verses.restored: And you know that he was manifested so that he might take away sins/misalignments, and sin/misalignment is not in him.

familiar.text: And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.

verses.restored: Everyone remaining in him does not keep sinning/misaligning; everyone continuing in sin/misalignment has neither seen him nor known him.

familiar.text: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither known him.

verses.restored: Little children, let no one lead you astray; the one doing righteousness/justice is righteous/just, just as that one is righteous/just.

familiar.text: Little children, let no man deceive you: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.

verses.restored: The one doing sin/misalignment is from the adversarial one, because the adversarial one sins/misaligns from beginning. For this the Son of Divine was manifested, so that he might dissolve the works of the adversarial one.

familiar.text: He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.

verses.restored: Everyone having been born of Divine does not keep doing sin/misalignment, because his seed remains in that one; and one is not able to keep sinning/misaligning, because one has been born of Divine.

familiar.text: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin; for his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.

verses.restored: In this the children of Divine and the children of the adversarial one are manifest: everyone not doing righteousness/justice is not from Divine, and the one not loving one's sibling.

familiar.text: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.

verses.restored: Because this is the message you heard from beginning: that we should love one another,

familiar.text: For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.

verses.restored: not as Cain, who was from the harmful one and slaughtered his sibling. And because of what did he slaughter him? Because his works were harmful, but those of his sibling righteous/just.

familiar.text: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

verses.restored: Do not marvel, siblings, if the world-system hates you.

familiar.text: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.

verses.restored: We know that we have passed from death into life, because we love the siblings. The one not loving remains in death.

familiar.text: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.

verses.restored: Everyone hating one's sibling is a murderer, and you know that every murderer does not have age-long life remaining in oneself.

familiar.text: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.

verses.restored: In this we have known love: that one laid down his life for us; and we ought to lay down lives for the siblings.

familiar.text: Hereby perceive we the love of God, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.

verses.restored: But whoever has the life-supplies of the world and sees one's sibling having need and shuts inward affections from that one, how does the love of the Divine remain in that one?

familiar.text: But whoso hath this world’s good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?

verses.restored: Little children, let us not love in word nor in tongue, but in work and truth.

familiar.text: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.

verses.restored: In this we will know that we are from truth, and before him we will persuade our heart,

familiar.text: And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.

verses.restored: because if our heart condemns us, the Divine is greater than our heart and knows all things.

familiar.text: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.

verses.restored: Beloved, if the heart does not condemn us, we have boldness toward the Divine,

familiar.text: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God.

verses.restored: and whatever we ask we receive from him, because we keep his commands and do the pleasing things before him.

familiar.text: And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.

verses.restored: And this is his command: that we trust the name of his Son Jesus Messiah and love one another, just as he gave command to us.

familiar.text: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.

verses.restored: And the one keeping his commands remains in him, and he in that one; and by this we know that he remains in us, from the Spirit whom he gave us.

familiar.text: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.

translation_notes: Born of Divine language concerns ongoing identity and practice; avoid perfectionist abuse while preserving the ethical force.
Love is materially tested by whether one opens inward affection and resources to siblings in need.
Divine is greater than our condemning heart: important pastoral safeguard against scrupulosity.
